summary: Nightly: Oct 6 hotfix block (18 sections) dispositioned, feed 46->47; 5 transcripts -> 2 takes + 3 skips; Method/Wowhead 0 moved; Icy Veins + Archon still walled

sources.detail: Attempted and Cloudflare-blocked from this runner (day 13, same UTC day as the two earlier nightlies). One bounded direct GET per registered page with the full browser header set: HTTP 403 on all six URLs, 5,487 B each, "Attention Required! | Cloudflare", zero tier-list-entry markers. Agrees with the independent published-evidence receipt (attemptedAt 2026-10-06T22:39:22Z: http 403, null resolved date on all six pages). Nothing parsed, so all 80 stored Icy Veins letters, the 2026-09-27 snapshots, the stored published dates and seasonVerified "s2" are unchanged.

Both registered pages fetched fresh this session by direct browser-header GET: HTTP 200, 184,377 B (mythic-plus) and 172,248 B (raiding). Parsed per .tier__tier block (.tier__title letter against .tier__entries data-original-title labels): 40/40 rows per bracket, 0 duplicates, 0 unmatched roster specs; the M+ page's dungeon-difficulty tierlist was rejected by ROSTER MATCH (its eight dungeon labels fail to map), not by position. Era-verified from the body ("Midnight Season 2", Devourer present) so seasonVerified stays "s2". Same-day recheck: all 80 letters identical to stored (0 moved), and the pages' own "Last Updated" lines still read 5th October 2026 (M+) and 10th August 2026 (raid), matching the stored published dates; no source-owned date advanced.

All six registered pages fetched fresh this session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200 (r.jina.ai not tried — dead on wowhead.com/guide/*). Parsed by unescaping \/ first, then the largest [tier-list=rows] block, tolerant [tier-label] whitespace, specs from the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] slug: 27+7+6 raid and 27+7+6 M+ = 80 rows, 0 unmatched, A+ present on the M+ DPS scale. Every title reads "Midnight Season 2" (raid healer with its known double space) with Devourer in both DPS lists, so seasonVerified stays "s2". Same-day recheck: 0 of 80 letters moved, and JSON-LD dateModified is unchanged (2026-08-28 … 2026-09-10), matching the stored published dates; no source-owned date advanced.

Not reachable: archon.gg remains behind its site-wide human-verification wall (failing in every committed manifest since 2026-08-26). Verified twice this run: the deterministic source-health receipt (attemptedAt 2026-10-06T22:38:37Z) records both registered routes (Heroic raid DPS, M+ DPS) at HTTP 403 with bodySignature "cloudflare-challenge" (5,743 B / 5,809 B), and one bounded direct GET from this session with the full browser header set returned HTTP 403, 3,345 B, "<title>Just a moment..." and zero __NEXT_DATA__ blocks. No challenge was solved, replayed or proxied, and no diagnostic was treated as data. Nothing was parsed, so every Archon observation — the 80 letters (seasonVerified "s2", retained in consensus under the owner-confirmed 2026-09-05 policy), the encounter tiers, the survivability tiers and all six numeric families — keeps its stored value and original date.

Fetched and parsed complete through the JSON API (no HTML, no proxy): manifest.json HTTP 200 and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200 (161,794 B, 44 blocks). Whitelisting categoryType dps|hps|tank + sortField lowerBound + keyRange undefined selects 3 blocks = 27+7+6 = 40 rows, all matching the roster. Not success: manifest.snapshotDate is still 2026-09-15 (completedAt 2026-09-15T14:25:48Z), and asOf is the source's own snapshotDate, never the run date. All 40 lowerBound values and all 40 numberOfCharacters counts are identical to stored at stored precision (the earlier 2026-10-06 run already merged the rankings-file movement), so nothing was merged. Letters are not read.

Recorded from the deterministic collector's legacy["wcl-live-raid"] receipt (wcl-fetch/evidence.json, attemptedAt 2026-10-06T22:36:41Z), verbatim: "Exact population medians have no verified sanctioned aggregate endpoint. Retained S1 observations unchanged. Supported WoW leaderboards are separate series; rdps is FFXIV-only, not a WoW outage test." This agent holds no WCL credentials and made no warcraftlogs.com request. Stored rows keep their values and 2026-08-10 date; the leaderboard series cannot green this requirement.

Verified by the trusted pre-agent fetch-stable-metrics.mjs step (checkedAt 2026-10-06T22:38:40Z): status success, all three meta pages HTTP 200 (71,310 / 42,299 / 40,903 B), 27+7+6 = 40 rows, no omitted specs; merged only via node src/apply-metrics.mjs metrics-fetch/updates.json. Not success because asOf is the source's own <time datetime> date, 2026-10-03 (10:10:23Z / 10:13:12Z / 10:11:13Z), three days old; values and dates are unchanged. Metric remains the top-50 ceiling, never popularity. check-stable-metrics passes.

Fetched fresh: all 27 DPS specs at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk, up to 3 attempts each. 23 returned charts; Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker and Subtlety Rogue returned the {"status":"error"} body on 3/3 attempts (same four as the earlier runs; Subtlety's stored 2026-09-23 chart stands). All 23 read simc_settings.tier "MID2" and ptr the string "0"; each chart's own timestamp is 2026-09-30. Nothing merged: all 23 are identical to the stored profiles at every target count. Not success because the coverage date is the data's own, under maxAgeDays 8. The 12.1.5 adoption hold does not fire: PHASES.livePatch is null, today is before LABEL_FLIP_DUE 2026-10-13, and nothing in this run's evidence says 12.1.5 is live.

reports/MID2_Raid.txt HTTP 200, 1,447,156 B, carrying a DPS Ranking block (HTML fallback not needed; MID1 stub not read). Header build string: "SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69933 Live (hotfix 2026-10-03/69933, git build HEAD cafc27227e, no-networking)". Longest-prefix mapping gives the best hero variant for 24 DPS specs; the 7 unmapped names are the tank profiles. Nothing merged: git HEAD unchanged and all 24 values identical to stored. Not success because the coverage date is the report's hotfix date, 2026-10-03, inside maxAgeDays 10.

Verified by the trusted pre-agent collector (checkedAt 2026-10-06T22:38:40Z): status success, /period/latest → /period/1083 HTTP 200 (196,746 B), 38 rows (25 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank) from the "Spec representation in top keys" section; role subtotals 27.6/32.5/20.1/20.0 vs printed 27.6/32.4/20.0/20.0, sum 100.2%. Undated source (dateBasis observed-undated-source, sourceAsOf null): identical values keep their existing asOf. Mage|Fire and Warlock|Affliction omitted by the chart with no stored row, so nothing held or fabricated; retiredSpecs empty. Merged only via apply-metrics on updates.json; check-stable-metrics passes.

All official channels swept inline plus the revision ledger. NEW: Blizzard's hotfix compilation (topic 2336376 post 1) moved v53 → v56 at 2026-10-06T22:36:40Z with an October 6 block: 18 new sections (5 Classes, 13 PvP), every one dispositioned in data/official-notes.json — the 5 Classes sections match the already-logged 2026-10-02 class-tuning entry line for line (irrelevant: already carried, 2026-09-22 precedent) and the 13 PvP sections are out of scope (rule 3c). One new live hotfix feed entry (46 → 47) records that the 10-02 class pass and the Ula'tek tuning went live; no spec lines, no set bonus touched. 12.1.5 preview topic 2344395 unchanged. Wowhead RSS 40 items, news index, blue tracker and the 12.1 thread (13 posts) show nothing else new. check-official-notes passes.

All 44 configured YouTube channelIds polled inline (41 class creators + 3 generalCreators), 44 OK. Seen-set from structured lanes only: 1,339 ids; 401 unseen in-cycle (bound 2026-06-18), the same backlog the earlier run filtered, with no new in-scope upload, so nothing new queued. Transcript summary verdict ok (5 requested / 5 fetched, 54 counted requests in 30 days). Distilled 2 takes (Sha Brewmaster M+ buff, live; Nintern Devourer mixed, 12.1.5 PTR preview — NOT LIVE), superseding 2 older same-lens takes; 3 verified skips (Supatease PvP notes read-aloud; two Musguete hero-talent guides). Queue 5 → 0.
